item.title: Slider 1.5 RC1 (24)
item.description:
Slider 1.5 RC1 (24)

  • Details panel: sets list with quick add, Local/Cloud chip, Last seen, tidier filename. Tags: search plus the 20 most popular tags, All tags window, matches decks with every picked tag. Reminders: quieter, with a synced label; fired reminders clear after 5 days. Settings: new Appearance tab.

item.title: Slider 1.5 RC1 (18)
item.description:
Slider 1.5 RC1 (18)

  • New look: Frosted White style with a soft grey nav in light mode. A permanent deck details panel replaces the card grid, row toolbar and Details window. Decks now always open by their exact file path or URL, so same-named decks never open the wrong file. Sets and Tags are now sidebar items, and Tags lets you filter by several tags at once. Settings has a cleaner, native layout.

item.title: Slider 1.5 RC1 (4)
item.description:
Slider 1.5 RC1 (4)

  • Slider now updates itself automatically — new builds arrive in the background.
  • Safari and Chrome are combined into one Browsers view; PowerPoint is the default view.
  • Settings is now a standard macOS window with a Diagnostics tab.
